tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: Countries FaxUp can send faxes to, with their calling codes. Read-only.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: What a fax costs on FaxUp, optionally for a given fax number and page count. Checks the number can be faxed (country served, not a mobile line). Read-only; charges nothing.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Prepares a fax of a PDF to a fax number and returns a confirmation link. The fax is NOT sent and nothing is charged until the person opens the link, checks the pages and number, pays or uses their FaxUp credits, and presses Send on faxup.net. The PDF comes as file_url (a public https link) or file_b

tools.name: find_agency_fax_number
tools.description: Look up the official fax number for a US government form or office (IRS, Social Security, USCIS, VA and more) from FaxUp's directory. Each number was read on the agency's own .gov page and carries that page's link and the date it was checked. Read-only; sends nothing.

tools.name: format_fax_number
tools.description: Turn a fax number into the international form FaxUp uses and check it can actually take a fax (right country, not a mobile or premium line). Read-only; sends nothing.

tools.name: get_country_fax_guide
tools.description: How to write a fax number for a country FaxUp reaches, with the leading-0 rule, which numbers are mobiles, the time zone, and a link to the full guide. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fax_tips
tools.description: How to make a document print clearly on a fax machine and what to put on a cover sheet. Read-only; general guidance, no personal data.

tools.name: compare_fax_services
tools.description: How FaxUp's pay-per-fax price compares with other fax apps and services (eFax, iFax, FAX.PLUS, Fax Burner and more): pricing model, App Store rating, and links to side-by-side pages. Prices were read on each service's own site / the App Store; quoted as-is. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Status of a prepared fax request: awaiting_confirmation, opened, handed_off (taken to faxup.net to send), cancelled, or expired; once the person has sent it on FaxUp, its delivery (sending, delivered or failed). Read-only.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:fax_an_insurance_appeal" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Prepare to fax an insurance appeal, claim or authorization to the right fax line.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "send_fax" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
